general_information.Description: - The course is applied in class having fully requirements learning tools. - Students are able to learn how to create a website by Adobe Flash. - Students have the opportunity to use the knowledge of colors, shapes ... to create motion graphics through the practice in class from the basic theories. - Student's project will be reviewed and evaluated by lecturer and all the students after class.
general_information.Tools: 1. FPT University: - Room with projector - Internet connection - Sticker notes - Whiteboard marker (include 3 color: blue, red and black) 2. Student's preparation: - Laptop with external mouse - Portfolio - A3, A4 paper size - Pencil, eraser, ruler - Tape

description: - The course is applied in class having fully requirements learning tools. - Students are able to learn how to create a website by Adobe Flash. - Students have the opportunity to use the knowledge of colors, shapes ... to create motion graphics through the practice in class from the basic theories. - Student's project will be reviewed and evaluated by lecturer and all the students after class.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Tracking of lecturer about student's activities on class (teamwork, Q&A, creating Portfolio).

1. Requirements for project exercises: - It will be conducted on A0 paper size - After evaluation, students capture and digitalize their result, printout and keep it in Portfolio, A4 paper size. - These best designs will be collected and submit to Group Leader as references for these next classes or used to hang in the classroom, exhibition. 2. Evaluation factors and grading: The product will be evaluated based on five factors included: - Structure, art, style 4 points - Method 3 points - Skill 3 point
